title: The Minimal Alchemical Inscription Window
statement:
Given two strings S and T, find the minimum window substring of S which contains all characters of T (including duplicate character frequencies).
If there is no such window, print -1.
If multiple valid windows exist with minimum length, print the one appearing earliest in S.
inputFormat:
First line: String S.
Second line: String T.
outputFormat: Print the shortest matching substring, or -1.
constraints:
1 <= len(S), len(T) <= 100000
Strings contain English letters.

sampleCases.explanation: "BANC" contains A, B, and C with length 4.
